    Shinichirou WATANABE

    Aka: 渡辺 信一郎

    • overview
    • comments
    Shinichirou WATANABE is best known for directing Terror in Resonance, The Animatrix, Samurai Champloo, and Cowboy Bebop: The Movie. Also known for being the director & ed director & screenplay & storyboard of Cowboy Bebop.
